args.sql:
WITH MeshMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.zoneref,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(CAST(sm.facetverts AS FLOAT) / sm.facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
        AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
        sm.uvmapqual AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh AS sm
    GROUP BY 
        sm.zoneref, sm.uvmapqual
),
SiteInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneregistry, 
        s.zonelabel
    FROM 
        sites AS s
)
SELECT 
    si.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    si.zonelabel AS site_name,
    mm.total_mesh_count,
    mm.high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    ROUND((mm.high_fidelity_mesh_count * 100.0 / mm.total_mesh_count), 2) AS high_fidelity_proportion_percent,
    mm.avg_complexity_ratio,
    mm.avg_resolution_mm,
    mm.avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
    mm.mesh_quality
FROM 
    MeshMetrics AS mm
JOIN 
    SiteInfo AS si ON mm.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
ORDER BY 
    site_code DESC;
